# Renovatio

> Renovatio is a free bilingual (English and Brazilian Portuguese) progressive web app for scheduling micro-tasks, reflecting on what was minimally good and recording three good gestures a day. It is inspired by behavioral activation and is not a medical treatment.

## Canonical URLs

- App: https://claudiobzrr.github.io/renovatio/
- English app: https://claudiobzrr.github.io/renovatio/?lang=en
- Portuguese app: https://claudiobzrr.github.io/renovatio/?lang=pt-BR
- English documentation: https://github.com/ClaudioBzrr/renovatio/blob/main/docs/README.md
- Portuguese documentation: https://github.com/ClaudioBzrr/renovatio/blob/main/docs/README.pt-BR.md
- Source repository: https://github.com/ClaudioBzrr/renovatio

## What Renovatio does

- Schedules one to three micro-tasks per day with a time and weekdays.
- Sends local browser reminders through a service worker.
- Guides a two-minute anticipation exercise and a one-minute sensory pause.
- Requires a written reflection about what was minimally good after each micro-task.
- Tracks a daily goal of three good gestures: kindness, connection and accomplishment.
- Shows history, a heatmap and encrypted local backups.
- Works offline after the first visit and can be installed as a PWA.

## Important limits

Renovatio does not diagnose, treat or replace psychotherapy, medical assessment, medication or emergency support. Exact background notification delivery is not guaranteed because the app does not use a Web Push server. All records stay on the device. Encrypted backups use AES-256-GCM with a user-chosen password; the password is not stored and cannot be recovered.

## Source and safety

The concept is inspired by the video “É por isso que você não sente prazer em nada (e como voltar a sentir)” from the Saúde da Mente channel. Renovatio is an independent project. In a crisis, call 188 (CVV, Brazil, 24h) or 192 (SAMU).

## Language policy

English is the default documentation language. The complete Portuguese documentation is a separate file.
